milestone.title: Path + Milestones subtitle support — emit intent.outcome through path_engine and render a description line on the Milestones row

intent.outcome: The raul Path tab and the raul Milestones tab each render a ↳ preview second line under the title, sourced from milestone.intent.outcome (first non-empty line, truncated). Operators can read what each milestone is about without opening the detail panel.

problem.description: raul already renders a `↳ <preview>` line under Path items (crates/raul/src/tui/path_view.rs::outcome_first_line reads item.milestone.intent.outcome and trims to the first non-empty line), but mp never sends it: the 10 `milestone: json!` sites in crates/mp/src/path_engine.rs (lines ~120, 419, 453, 684, 741, 854, 931, 1007, 1052, 1076) omit intent, so every preview is blank. The Milestones tab has the same gap one layer down: `mp list milestones` (crates/mp/src/commands/list.rs) emits no intent and `--include intent` is silently ignored, so MilestoneSummary (crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs:438, parsed in runner_helpers.rs:197) has nothing to show, and render_milestones_table (lane_lists.rs:429) draws 1-line rows.

in_scope: WP1: add `"intent": {"outcome": <full outcome string or "">}` to all 10 milestone json! blocks in path_engine.rs via one shared helper (raul does the first-line trim).
WP1: add the same additive `intent.outcome` key to each `mp list milestones` row in commands/list.rs.
WP1: regenerate tests/fixtures/json-shape/path.json and list-milestones.json with `make regen-goldens` and review the diff (additive key only).
WP2: MilestoneSummary.intent_outcome: String parsed from the list row; render_milestones_table rows become 2 lines (title, then dim `↳ <first line>`), reusing path_view::outcome_first_line.
WP2: depends_on_depths indentation applies to both lines; cursor/scrollbar math counts 2-line rows.
New tests: crates/mp/tests/path_engine_intent.rs, crates/raul/tests/tui_path_preview.rs, tui_milestone_subtitle.rs, milestone_indent.rs, milestone_scrollbar.rs.
out_of_scope: Changing the preview truncation rules in path_view.rs.
Honoring `--include intent` generically (the key is emitted unconditionally; the silent-ignore of unknown --include values is logged separately).
Row-height changes on tabs other than Milestones.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every PathAction kind emitted by mp path (all 10 path_engine sites) and every mp list milestones row carries milestone intent.outcome (full string, "" when absent); shape goldens are regenerated additively.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test path_engine_intent --no-fail-fast && cargo nextest run -p mp --test suite_misc --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/^json_shape_baseline::/)'

acceptance_criteria.description: raul's Path tree shows the ↳ preview populated from mp's intent.outcome for a fixture plan.
MilestoneSummary carries intent_outcome parsed from mp list milestones and the Milestones table renders a 2-line row (title + dim ↳ first line; bare ↳ when empty).
depends_on indentation applies to both row lines and cursor/scrollbar math stays correct with 2-line rows.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --test milestone_indent --test milestone_scrollbar --test tui_milestones_table_cursor --no-fail-fast

acceptance_criteria.description: mp and raul tests, clippy, fmt, and consumer-surface lint are clean.
